sourceOffers.scope: Small editable specimen-board exporter for the SVG board utility, limited to board input, editing interaction, and export validation
sourceOffers.question: Which board input and editing interaction should the specimen-board exporter support first?

options.label: File-defined board with explicit edits
options.tradeoff: Keeps input inspectable and validation explicit, but requires agreeing on the board file shape first.
options.acceptanceExample: Given a board input file, when the exporter runs, then it produces an SVG export and reports invalid cells without changing the input.

source.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Inline board data with single-edit operations
options.tradeoff: Makes the smallest slice easy to try, but leaves file handling and bulk edits undecided.
options.acceptanceExample: Given inline board data and one edit operation, when the exporter runs, then it applies the edit and exports SVG or rejects the edit with a reason.

source.quote: Build a small editable specimen-board exporter for our SVG board utility. Board input and editing interaction are undecided.

options.label: Export gated by board validation
options.tradeoff: Prevents bad exports from shipping, but requires deciding which board rules block export.
options.acceptanceExample: Given a board input plus an export check, when validation fails, then the exporter blocks export and names the failing board rule.
